name: Queen of Spades — Royal Costume
name_es: Reina de picas con vestuario real
source_content:
Ultra-detailed fantasy playing card illustration of the Queen of Spades, featuring the exact same young woman’s face from the reference image, centered inside a royal playing card frame. She wears a luxurious black-and-gold queen outfit with spade symbols, an ornate golden crown with a black spade jewel, glowing embers around her. The card border is engulfed in dramatic realistic fire, sparks and smoke floating through the scene. Cinematic lighting, warm orange fire glow reflecting on her face, dark fantasy style, hyper-realistic face, ultra sharp focus, 8k, extremely detailed textures, symmetrical composition, magical atmosphere, epic, unique, majestic, high contrast, professional digital art.

El sujeto se sienta elegantemente en el suelo.Ella tiene una expresión de risa, y su mirada está dirigida hacia arriba.

El fondo debe ser una composición artística monocromática (blanco y negro) que represente un primer plano suave desde el lado de la misma cara en el perfil
